title: Nasdaq, Börse Stuttgart and others urge EU to rethink €100bn DLT cap
summary: Nasdaq and Börse Stuttgart Group are among the market infrastructure players calling on European lawmakers to rethink a planned €100 billion DLT Pilot Regime cap.
content: Nasdaq, Börse Stuttgart Group, and other market infrastructure players are calling on European lawmakers to reconsider a planned €100 billion cap under the DLT Pilot Regime. The coalition is urging the European Union to rethink these regulatory limits to better support the growth and testing of distributed ledger technology within European financial markets.

title: Hunter Biden details LAPTOP memecoin’s airdrop and burn-or-charity rules ahead of launch
summary: About 30% of the supply is tied to 30 public real-world events that either burn or donate the tokens depending on the results.
content: Hunter Biden has released details regarding the airdrop and tokenomics for the LAPTOP memecoin ahead of its official launch. The project features unique rules where approximately 30 percent of the token supply is tied directly to 30 public real-world events. Depending on the outcomes of these events, the associated tokens will either be permanently burned or donated to charity.
